name: Litigation Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Litigation Committee will conduct
  a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address
  the agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  4th
  Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON I TELEPHONIC I VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Meeting
  www.beverlyhills.orq!MyCommiftee
  Meeting ID: 516 191 2424
  Passcode: 90210

  You can also dial in by phone:
  +1 669 900 9128 US
  +1 833 548 0282 (ToIl-Free)

  One tap mobile
  +1 66990091 28,,51 61 91 2424# US
  +18335480282,516191 2424# US (Toll-Free)

  Friday, August 2, 2024
  5:00 PM

Please be advised that pre-entry metal detector screening requirements are now in place
in City Hall. Members of the public are requested to plan visits accordingly.

 In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public can view this
meeting through live webcast at www.beverlvhills.org/live and on BH Channel 10 or Channel 35
on Spectrum Cable, and can participate in the teleconference/video conference by using the link
above. Written comments may be emalled to mayorandcitycoundll(d.beverlyhills.orci and will also
  be taken during the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City Council
  Liaison /Arts and Culture Commission Committee. Beverly Hills Liaison meetings will be in-
  person at City Hall.

  AGENDA

1) Public Comment
  a) Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item not listed on the agenda

2) Discussion of Williams v. City of Beverly Hills and Greene v. City of Beverly Hills
 3) Adjournment

Huma Ahmed
City Clerk

Posted: July 29, 2024

  A DETAILED LIAISON AGENDA PACKET IS AVAILABLE FOR REWEW AT
